config.${common.id}:server_settings/${mo: Allow Careful Break
When enabled, blocks broken by players will send their drops directly to the player's inventory instead of dropping them on the ground.
Allow XP Bar Mending
Uses the XP accumulated in the XP bar for the mending enchantment as if the XP was just picked up, automatically repairing items.
Allow Creative Kill
Allow instant kill in creative mode for all players.
Split Scattered Items
Controls the vanilla behavior where items dropped from certain inventories are split into sub-stacks instead of dropping as full stacks. Set to false to drop items as full stacks.
Stack Shulker Boxes
Control how shulker boxes are stacked for all players on the server.
Angry Zombified Piglins Drop XP
When enabled, angry zombified piglins drop XP when killed no matter if they are killed by a player or not.
Command Base to Base
Enable the command '/base2base' to convert numbers between different bases (e.g., binary, decimal, hexadecimal).
Command Batch
Enable the command '/batch' to execute multiple commands in a single command block or chat message.
Command Ender Chest
Enable the command '/enderchest' to open the ender chest of the specified player.
Command Signal
Enable the command '/signal' to get a block with the specified signal strength.
Command Stats Score
Enable the command '/statscore' to view statistics of players on the scoreboard.
